mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (1-month change < 0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market contraction that triggers corporate cost-cutting and reduced hiring, leading to lower near-term earnings growth and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (1-month change < 0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profit growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines (1-month change < 0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases (1-month change > 0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending power and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines (1-month change < 0) and UNRATE increases (1-month change > 0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases (1-month change > 0), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
